Terms & conditions

Passengers are entitled to one piece of winter sports equipment free of charge in addition to their standard baggage allowance on all eligible fares (excluding Basic and Light fares). Applicable on: LH/LX/OS/SN/VL/WK marketed and operated flights. Codeshare flights are excluded. Winter sports equipment consist of: One pair of skis or one snowboard. One bag containing one pair of ski poles and one pair of ski or snowboard boots. One helmet. Maximum permitted dimension: 200 cm length. Also please ensure that your sports baggage and special baggage is registered as early as possible, and in any case no later than 72 hours before departure.

Transport of sports equipment is subject to available cargo hold capacity. Carriage cannot be guaranteed in all cases and depends on the respective load situation of the flight.
